_doc: Clan estate buildings (FAM-006, ClanEstate). The clan builds one project at a time, paid from the clan treasury; the work finishes after build_days of world time (the patriarch need not wait). Per building: id, name, description, levels (index 0 = level 1). Per level: cost (treasury spirit stones), build_days, optional min_realm (realm id the clan head must have reached), effects. A building's effects are those of its current level (not summed over levels). Effect keys: income (spirit stones into the treasury each month), reputation (clan reputation each month), qi_density (fraction added to seclusion qi density at the clan seat abode, e.g. 0.2 = +20%), ward (fraction by which misfortune encounters while exploring the seat's region and road ambushes on arriving there are reduced; summed, capped at 0.9), training_speed (fraction added to the days of children's monthly training), herbs ({item id: quantity} harvested to the patriarch's inventory each month). Top level: max_projects (only 1 is supported).

buildings.name: Ancestral Hall
buildings.description: Tablets of the ancestors and the clan's records. Its incense draws admirers and binds the family together.

buildings.name: Spirit Field
buildings.description: Terraced fields watered with spring qi, tended by clan servants.

buildings.name: Alchemy Room
buildings.description: A furnace chamber where clan disciples refine common pills for sale.

buildings.name: Protective Array
buildings.description: Array flags buried around the estate. They keep intruders out and the gathered qi in.

buildings.name: Scripture Library
buildings.description: Jade slips and manuals collected for the clan's young.
